column3: The crew view reads the home stream's space threads instead of captain.get, and the home thread summary gains `run` (defaulting to 1, as captain.get does); New Captain always sends a model, preselecting the project coordinator's, so no Captain is created unable to delegate
column4: XIN-23 review: captain.get ran again on every crew status change, and a Captain created without a model could not delegate or fork; home already carries every other crew field
column5: plugins/workspace/workspace.test.ts asserts run on the home stream (gate test --only=plugins/workspace pass); web/src/lib/captains.test.ts covers crewOf, the model decision and the parsers
